worldcombat.skill.icepunch.summary: A frost-covered fist strikes the target and leaves a chill that slows it. If the target is already chilled, or standing in water, the frost is pulled away and the target is frozen solid instead (longer while wet).
worldcombat.skill.icepunch.use.0: Coat a target in a slowing chill at close range
worldcombat.skill.icepunch.use.1: Finish with a freeze against an already chilled or soaked target
worldcombat.skill.icepunch.use.2: Stop a key target in its tracks
worldcombat.skill.icepunch.description.0: The punch deals %1$s contact and punch damage over a reach of about %2$s blocks.
worldcombat.skill.icepunch.description.1: On a hit the target is coated in a chill that slows it for %1$s.
worldcombat.skill.icepunch.description.2: If the target is already chilled or standing in water, the chill is consumed and it is instead frozen for %1$s (x1.5 while wet).
worldcombat.skill.icepunch.deepfreeze.on: Deep freeze: a longer freeze and a longer chill, but a lighter punch and a longer cooldown.
worldcombat.skill.icepunch.deepfreeze.of: Flash freeze: a heavier punch and a faster cycle, but shorter control.
worldcombat.skill.icepunch.timing: Range %1$s blocks; wind-up %2$s s, recovery %3$s s, cooldown %4$s s, costing %5$s PP.
worldcombat.skill.icepunch.growth.0: From level %1$s the power rises to %2$s.
worldcombat.skill.icepunch.growth.1: From level %1$s the power rises to %2$s and the freeze duration to %3$s.
worldcombat.skill.icepunch.preference.de: On: freeze duration x1.4, chill duration x1.2, but punch power x0.9 and cooldown +5 ticks, for locking down a key target. Off (flash freeze): a heavier punch and a faster cycle, but shorter control.
worldcombat.skill.icepunch.preference.ai: Beyond this distance the user closes in first. The ice punch reach is short, so a large value often still cannot connect.
On: targets already chilled or standing in water rank first, since this punch freezes them; off: order by ordinary melee only.
